cohort: 5,469 women who sought obstetric fistula repair between 1994 and 2017 in Tanzania, Uganda, Kenya, Malawi, Rwanda, Somalia, South Sudan, Zambia, and Ethiopia
finding: Over time, the odds of genito-urinary fistula being iatrogenic nearly doubled among all births resulting in fistula and rose by 37% among cesarean births resulting in fistula.
mod_finding: The odds of genito-urinary fistula being iatrogenic rose by 37% among cesarean births resulting in fistula.
country: Tanzania, Uganda, Kenya, Malawi, Rwanda, Somalia, South Sudan, Zambia, and Ethiopia
